title: Corporate VPN Connection Guide
content: To connect to the corporate VPN install the approved client, open the profile named CorpVPN, authenticate with SSO, and confirm the tunnel status is Connected. If the VPN drops, restart the client and check network DNS settings.

title: Office Wi-Fi Troubleshooting
content: Join the corporate wifi SSID CorpSecure using your employee credentials. Forget the network and reconnect if authentication fails. Disable random MAC addressing on Windows and renew the DHCP lease.

title: Password Policy
content: Passwords must be at least 12 characters and include mixed case, a number, and a symbol. Employees must not share passwords. Expired passwords require a self-service reset after identity verification.

title: MFA Enrollment Guide
content: Enable multi-factor authentication in the security portal. Register an authenticator app, verify a one-time code, and store backup codes securely. Lost MFA devices require identity verification before reset.

title: Network Printer Setup
content: Add a printer by IP using the standard TCP/IP port. Install the approved driver from the software catalog. Print a test page and verify queue status.

title: Outlook Configuration
content: Configure Outlook with modern authentication. Sign in with corporate email, allow MFA prompts, and sync folders. Clear credential manager entries if repeated login loops occur.

title: Report Phishing Procedure
content: Do not click suspicious links. Forward the message to phishing@company.example and then delete it. Contact the security team if credentials were entered.

title: Loaner Laptop Procedure
content: Request a loaner laptop through the hardware request form. Collect from the IT desk with employee ID. Return within the approved loan period.

title: Cafeteria Menu Policy
content: The cafeteria publishes weekly menus. Dietary requests go to facilities. This document is unrelated to networking or password troubleshooting.

title: Approved Git Client Install
content: Git is available from the approved software catalog. Request installation through IT Requests for low-risk catalog items. Do not download unsigned installers.
